evidence: SOURCE CHECK (frozen .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r4/task). tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/scoring.toml and tests/Dockerfile are byte-identical to rules/projects/webdev-task-template (diff empty); test.sh sha256 bd682592...aabe5aa, score.py 13de2b38...c04e. I walked test.sh against staged-task-contract.md 'tests/test.sh' items 1-8 and quality-checks.md #21. (1) Zero reward is written first: write_zero_reward at test.sh:60 writes reward.txt 0.0, a reward.json carrying reward + all five dimensions + gates_passed/floors_passed/weighted_score/graded/no_op (line 8), and ctrf.json. trap cleanup EXIT (line 61) calls ensure_reward (lines 20-23, 39). No shell exec: the only match is find -exec at line 86. bash -n passes; 0 CR bytes. (2) Refuses missing /app/server.js (68-70) and any symlink outside /app/node_modules or whose readlink -f target escapes it (72-83); each refusal exits 0 with the zero record already in place. (3) /app copied to /tmp/submission (90-95); app launched via setsid env -i with only PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT=3000, DB_PATH under setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups (104-111); /tests is chmod go-rwx (12) and LOG_DIR chmod 700 under umask 077 (3, 11), so the unprivileged app can neither read rubric files nor forge reward files. (4) Liveness probe on /api/health then / (42-58), 120 x 0.25 s loop (115-122), exits 0 with the zero reward if never ready, before any RewardKit call. (5) Restart helper generated by heredoc + sed placeholders, chmod 755, APP_RESTART_HELPER exported (127-193); functional judge.toml:17-18 wires restart_mcp.py with $APP_RESTART_HELPER. (6) {app_context} substituted into every /tests/*/*/prompt.md (195-201); tests/app_context.md exists, and a crash there exits via set -e into the trap with the zero record. (7) scored dir wiped (212) then gates suite (213), score.py (217): 0 continue, 1 exit keeping detailed record, other -> write_zero_reward (218-222). (8) scored suite (224) then score.py || write_zero_reward (227). A failed/timed-out rewardkit run exits 0 leaving the record from the gates-stage score.py, which always has reward 0.0 because scored/reward.json was removed at line 212. SIMULATION (evidence/21/score_py_exit_paths.txt): frozen score.py + scoring.toml on synthetic suite outputs in a scratchpad: gate fail -> exit 1, reward 0.0000; gates-only -> exit 0, reward 0.0000 (no stale positive between suites); full -> 0.6600 (=0.6*0.5+0.2*1+0.2*0.8); functional 0.04 below floor -> 0.0000; missing gates reward.json, non-numeric or missing dimension -> exit 2, which test.sh maps to write_zero_reward. Every path I traced leaves a well-formed reward. BUDGET NESTING: gates 2 dims x batched timeout 600 = 1200 < 1500; scored functional mode=individual 12 criteria x 700 = 8400 (rewardkit 0.1.7 judges.py:467-493 runs agent criteria sequentially) + polish 900 + visual 900 = 10200 < 11100; 1500+11100 = 12600 < task.toml [verifier].timeout_sec 13200 (template-reference values unchanged). BRIEF SUPPORT for launch assumptions (also row 23): instruction.md:15 (node /app/server.js, port 3000/PORT, GET /api/health never touching the DB, /app/app.db honouring DB_PATH); integration.md:5-10 (0.0.0.0, health answers before DB work), 15-23 (no symlinks outside /app/node_modules, launched from another cwd as a locked-down account); hireops_rules.md:206-209 (only PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT, DB_PATH guaranteed). ADVERSARIAL: a broken app that serves /api/health but has a dead UI passes the liveness probe by design; the render/constraints gates have to catch it, which is outside this row. A conforming alternative that could get 0: an app with /app/server.js as a symlink to a build output, refused at lines 72-83, but integration.md:15-18 forbids that publicly, so it is not a hidden requirement; an app needing more than ~30 s before any HTTP answer, though the brief asks health to answer before DB work. No contract defect found. LESSONS FILE: the patterns bearing on this row are lesson 4 (gates hard-zero the reward: the template contract here, unchanged), lesson 11 (judge infra crashes zero a dimension: in rewardkit 0.1.7 a non-zero judge CLI exit raises at judges.py:551-555, so rewardkit fails, test.sh:224-225 exits and the reward is 0 rather than unwritten) and lesson 19 (the scripted golden harness launched like test.sh). None changes the verdict, because the reward is still always written. RISK (why risk=true): no full configured test.sh run was measured. raw-evidence-index.json (artifact hashes re-verified, all 8 match) says explicitly 'Full configured grading/workload ... absent'; via-solve.log is a scripted driver, not a test.sh/RewardKit run. In rewardkit 0.1.7 a schema-parse failure retries up to _MAX_JUDGE_RETRIES=3 (judges.py:229, 556-563), each up to 700 s, so a judge that keeps answering slowly and unparseably could push the 12 sequential functional sessions past the 11100 s scored budget. The rollout would still score 0 (always written) but would lose graded credit. Whether the actual end-to-end launch works under the real verifier image is unmeasured.
